title: Mai Haƙuri
intro: Tun da daɗewa, a farkon zamanin tarihin ɗan adam, rayuka biyu sun tsaya a gaban Mahaliccinsu da hadayu. An karɓi ɗaya, ɗaya kuma ba a karɓa ba. Abin da ya biyo baya zai zama babban bala'i na farko tsakanin 'yan'uwa - ɗaya na kamewa da haƙuri da kuma ɗayan na ɗaukar fansa mai zafi. Za ku iya gano ko ni wanene?
clues: An haife ni a farkon kwanakin rayuwar ɗan adam a duniya
Ni ɗa ne ga mutane na farko da suka taɓa rayuwa a duniya
Na taɓa miƙa hadaya daga mafi kyawun garkena don faranta wa Mahaliccina rai
An karɓi tayina daga sama, yayin da aka ƙi tayin ɗan'uwana
Lokacin da aka yi mini barazanar kisa, na zaɓi kada in ɗaga hannuna kan ɗan'uwana
Na zama mutum na farko a tarihin ɗan adam da wani ya kashe shi ba bisa ƙa'ida ba

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Habila (Habila), ɗan Adamu
Kabil (Ka'ab), ɗan Adam
Adamu, ɗan adam na farko
Nuhu (Nuhu)
Ibrahim (Ibrahim)

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Kisa ta farko a tarihin ɗan adam
Babban ambaliyar ruwa ta Nuhu
Rushewar rundunar Fir'auna
Hadayar Isma'ila ta Ibrahim
Yaƙin Jalut (Goliath)
trial.answer: Kisa ta farko a tarihin ɗan adam

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Tumaki da aka miƙa a matsayin hadaya mai daɗi
Babban akwatin katako
Sanda da ta rikide ta zama maciji
Tsuntsun dawaki yana ɗauke da saƙon sarauta
Wata rami mai kama da wuta mai ci
location.answer: Tumaki da aka miƙa a matsayin hadaya mai daɗi

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ya zama wanda aka fara kashewa a tarihin ɗan adam
Na tsira daga ambaliyar ruwa mai yawa a cikin jirgin ruwa na katako
Ya rayu a cikin cikin babban kifi
Ya yi mulki a kan aljanu, mutane, da iska
Yawo tsawon shekaru arba'in a cikin babban daji
outcome.answer: Ya zama wanda aka fara kashewa a tarihin ɗan adam

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
